description: This Swift source file defines a class CanvasSchemeHandler that implements WKURLSchemeHandler for custom URL scheme handling in a WebKit web view. It manages serving local files, handling session-specific directories, and generating fallback HTML pages when resources are missing.

classes.name: CanvasSchemeHandler
classes.description: A class conforming to WKURLSchemeHandler to handle custom URL schemes for serving session-specific files in a WebView.

methods.name: webView(_:start:)
methods.description: Handles starting a URL scheme task by serving appropriate content based on the URL.

methods.name: webView(_:stop:)
methods.description: Handles stopping a URL scheme task, currently a no-op.

methods.name: response(for:)
methods.description: Generates a CanvasResponse containing MIME type and data for the requested URL, handling session validation, file resolution, and fallback pages.

methods.name: resolveFileURL(sessionRoot:requestPath:)
methods.description: Resolves the actual file URL within a session directory for a given request path, supporting directory index fallback.

methods.name: resolveIndex(in:)
methods.description: Returns the URL of index.html or index.htm if they exist within the provided directory.

methods.name: isFileURL(_:withinDirectory:)
methods.description: Checks if a given file URL is within the specified directory boundary.

methods.name: html(_:title:)
methods.description: Constructs a CanvasResponse with an HTML page containing the specified body.

methods.name: welcomePage(sessionRoot:)
methods.description: Creates a welcome page indicating Canvas readiness and guide to create index.html.

methods.name: scaffoldPage(sessionRoot:)
methods.description: Provides a default scaffold page or fallback if no resource bundle is available.

methods.name: loadBundledResourceData(relativePath:)
methods.description: Loads resource data embedded within the app bundle based on a relative path.

methods.name: textEncodingName(forMimeType:)
methods.description: Determines the text encoding name based on the MIME type.
